item_alpha_wolf_fang_description: A partitularly long tooth, once belonging to the leader of a pack of wolves.
item_ancestral_blood_description: Blood drawn from Lazarus, the first vampire.
item_ancient_hide_description: Scale covered hide of a giant, archaic beast living at the center of the world.
item_ancient_membrane_description: An incredibly durable yet lightweight membrane, taken from the wing of a creature believed to have gone extinct millions of years ago.
item_ancient_seed_description: A hardened, very old seed that seems to possess magical properties.
item_animated_ingot_description: Metal ingot smelted from pieces of Living Metal.
item_animated_scraps_description: Pieces of an unknown metal. They move erratically when left alone, and pulsate with an eerie light.
item_astral_goo_description: A chunk of a giant, nightmarish monster that surpasses a mortal\'s wildest fantasy. You are not sure of its utility.
item_bag_of_choking_powder_description: A bag of irritant powder that Giant Moth wings are covered in. It allows for a more aerodynamic flight, but irritates the airways of most other living beings.
item_banshee_claw_description: The sharp and resilient claw of a Banshee
item_banshee_horn_description: Twisted, black horn of a Banshee
item_banshee_scale_description: Hard scale making up the skin of a Banshee
item_bat_tooth_description: Frontal tooth of a Vampire Bat. Sometimes used as alchemic ingredient.
item_bat_wing_description: The resilient wing of a Vampire Bat.
item_beast_pelt_description: The pelt of a wild animals, usually refined to make Leather.
item_black_hide_description: The skin of a horrible monster preying in the dark.
item_black_iron_ingot_description: Extremely resistant metal alloy. It\'s formula is jealously guarded by the pirate blacksmiths.
item_black_iron_scraps_description: Scraps of the famed metal, ready to be fused into an ingot.
item_black_ooze_description: A dense, sticky black substance. It is believed to be a byproduct of the soul-stealing process from the eldritch gods.
item_boar_tusk_description: A well preserved tusk from a wild boar.
item_bone_fragment_description: Fragments of a bone once belonging to a valiant soldier.
item_bottled_sand_spirit_description: A powerful Djinn spirit trapped in a bottle.
item_celestial_metal_description: An ingot made from recovered scraps.
item_celestial_scraps_description: Hard metal with an impossibly high fusion point. Must be some kind of alloy made with unknown ingredients.
item_chain_link_description: Surprisingly light ring of unknown metal, seems to possess some magical properties.
item_chain_of_redemption_description: Light but very resistant chain that seems to reflect part of the incoming force, magical or not.
item_charred_heart_description: A coal chunk vaguely resembling the shape of a heart, still weakly beating despite its condition, and the fact that it has been extracted from the owner\'s chest.
item_cleansing_potion_description: A clear blue concoction able to restore the original properties of items degraded due to the corruption.
item_cloth_description: A versatile textile usually employed in the production of robes or cloaks.
item_cobweb_bundle_description: Unrefined mass of Giant Spider\'s cobwebs. Can be refined into an unbreakable textile.
item_coin_purse_description: A purse full of coins of various denominations. Worth it\'s weight in silver.
item_containment_orb_description: Glass orb reinforced by magic, needed to contain powerful but dangerous artifacts.
item_copper_ingot_description: An ingot made of copper. Can be smelted in any shape to produce all kinds of equipment.
item_copper_ore_description: A malleable metal with a distinctive reddish-brown hue.
item_corsair_leather_description: Exotic kind of leather that comes from processed Monkey Hide.
item_cottontail_fur_description: The fur of the elusive Golden Rabbit.
item_crimson_brew_description: A thick potion displaying a vivid red color.
item_crusader_insigna_description: The woven seal of the Crusaders of the Eastern Kingdom. A symbol of hope for their people, heralding light in their darkest moments.
item_cursed_silver_description: An extremely light chunk of silver that glows with an eerie light.
item_deep_sea_velvet_description: A piece of Exotic Velvet blessed with eldritch properties from the depth of the abyss.
item_diamond_description: A very hard gem that appears to be impossible to scratch. Only a handful of these have ever been found on the surface, making it an ideal gift for powerful kings or emperors.
item_dreamwrought_hide_description: Hide fetched from a dangerous, colossal dream creature. Due to its origin it is very versatile, but less resistant.
item_dreamwrought_larva_description: The first stage of development of an insect materialized from a dream.
item_dreamwrought_mane_description: The thick mane of a Dreamwrought Beast.
item_dreamwrought_silk_description: Extremely flexible cloth woven from a dream like thread. Due to its origin it is very versatile, but less resistant.
item_dreamwrought_steel_description: Very malleable metal materialized from a dream by an expert blacksmith. Due to its origin it is very versatile, but less resistant.
item_elastic_membrane_description: A sheath of a weird material that could be either natural or artificial.
item_eldritch_seal_description: The Seal of the Outer God, worn by his priests to show their unwavering faith.
item_eldritch_shred_description: A fragment of a larger tapestry, it can be combined with other pieces to reveal the complete picture.
item_eldritch_tendril_description: One of the tendrils of a Beholder. You can feel its powerful magic still flowing into the appendage.
item_electric_catalyst_description: Arcane catalyst used to balance the properties of powerful, unstable elements.
item_elixir_of_affinity_description: Very difficult to brew even for the most skilled alchemists, made from ingredients of legendary rarity, this elixir acts as a neutral glue for substances that would otherwise reject each other.
item_elixir_of_learning_description: Magic concoction that briefly boosts the ability of a student to learn new concepts.
item_elongated_bone_description: An unusually long bone, probably coming from a hind leg of a war hound.
item_elysian_wood_description: An extremely rare wood found in a minority of trees in the Southern Lands. Seems to keep sprouting new branches even when chopped off the original tree.
item_emerald_description: Precious green gemstone, widely employed in the field of jewelry.
item_essence_of_corruption_description: Pitch black potion distilled from the Black Ooze. When purified through additional steps, it can manifest unique properties.
item_exalted_powder_description: Alchemic powder enriched to display new magical properties. Only this powder is pure enough to be merged with the Primordial, increasing its strength.
item_exotic_velvet_description: Very smooth and prestigious textile imported by pirates from distant lands.
item_eye_of_the_abyss_description: Seeing its dimensions makes you wonder what kind of monsters lurk in the ocean\'s depth. Powerful and very rare alchemic ingredient.
item_eyes_of_the_swordsman_description: The eyes of the first general of the Sha\'huri Army. A unique battle trophy.
item_feather_description: A very light feather with a variety of uses.
item_fire_catalyst_description: Arcane catalyst used to balance the properties of powerful, unstable elements.
item_fireproof_oil_description: An oil obtained through unknown means that allow anything covered in it to be immune to fire.
item_flake_of_infinity_description: A piece of an incredibly powerful being, that somehow crossed the threshold between the mortal world and something else.
item_fleetfoot_fabric_description: A magic textile enchanted by unknown rituals. Grants the wearer a reduction in its weight.
item_flux_limiter_description: An organic mass of nerves and tendrils, shaped to have specific optic properties.
item_frost_crystal_description: An extremely sharp crystal displaying minor magical properties. Despite its nature, it never melts.
item_frost_nucleus_description: The magic pebble around which an Ice Elemental can form.
item_frostmetal_ingot_description: An ingot of a peculiar type of metal that mixes the properties of iron and ice.
item_frostmetal_ore_description: A raw piece of very strong and cold metal. Can be smelted into ingots.
item_frozen_egg_description: The egg of a Snow Wyvern. It\'s unique properties seem to increase the danger cold weather poses to those around it.
item_frozen_scale_description: A scale of the fearsome Snow Wyvern. Always a few degrees lower than room temperature.
item_ghostwood_stump_description: Ghostwood replacement for a lost leg, a common occurrence in the pirate\'s world.
item_ghostwoood_board_description: Board of Ghostwood ready to be employed for the creation of various equipments.
item_giant_moth_wing_description: A moth wing of unusual dimensions, possesses greater elasticity than its smaller counterparts.
item_giant_shell_fragment_description: A piece of an extremely hard shell.
item_gift_of_light_description: A mysterious reagent gifted by a god of light.
item_glass_description: Sand heated to form transparent, smooth surface.
item_gold_ingot_description: A precious metal widely employed in the production of high-grade military equipment for the Imperial Army.
item_gold_scraps_description: Scraps of gold retrieved from broken equipment. Can be smelted into ingot.
item_green_slime_description: Green, transparent jelly that makes up the body of Slimes.
item_heart_of_darkness_description: The heart of a being predating existence itself. An expression of hatred unmatched by anything else.
item_holy_water_description: Water blessed with a secret ritual by a bishop of the capital. Can be used to remove curses from items or living creatures, but due to the length of the rituals involved in its production only the most wealthy individuals can afford it.
item_ice_catalyst_description: Arcane catalyst used to balance the properties of powerful, unstable elements.
item_ice_fiber_description: A thin thread of ice-like textile, likely made with a technique only known to the Trolls.
item_infected_blood_description: Blood carrying the mysterious infection that can turn regular undead into ghouls. Can be used as alchemic ingredient.
item_infernite_description: Mysterious mineral forged by the hottest fire, remarkably resistant yet light as a feather. Oddly cold at touch, allows to forge items with impossible aerodynamics, not reproducible with any other means.
item_infusion_of_wisdom_description: An oil that can be applied to certain armors or garments, able to boost the learning speed of those who wear it.
item_iron_ingot_description: A durable and resistant metal, usually employed to craft battle armaments.
item_ivory_description: Smooth, pale white material derived from tusks of animals.
item_kabelian_metal_description: Rare metal from the eastern lands. Displays some unique properties, likely coming from the psyonic ability of the people who smelted it.
item_kaunian_fabric_description: Thick and hard fabric displaying properties more close to those found in metal. Doesn\'t display any magical property, but will do an excellent job in protecting its owner.
item_kindlequartz_description: Cold at touch, this peculiar gem reflects light with a flame-like shimmer. Seems to draw the curiosity of the nearby wildlife.
item_large_iris_description: An intact eye of a slain Beholder. Can be used as a perfectly focused magic lens.
item_laroxian_fabric_description: An incredibly resistant but light fabric, enchanted with a variety of spells to enhance its properties.
item_leather_description: A resistant but light material, usually employed in the making of armors or armor paddings.
item_living_sap_description: The sap from a living tree.
item_living_vine_description: A long, resistant vine ripped from an ancient tree that moves on its own volition.
item_long_serpent_fang_description: A very long and sharp fang taken from a wild Spitfang.
item_metamorphic_sand_description: Looks like regular sand at first glance, but displays peculiar shapeshifting properties.
item_missing_page_description: A single page of some old book.
item_mithril_description: A legendary alloy, unbreakable by traditional means. Its creation remains a guarded secret of the dwellers of the Forgotten Lands.
item_monkey_hide_description: The hide of a Capuchin Monkey, a small primate usually kept as pet and assistant by some Skull Island pirates.
item_mutant_hide_description: Extremely thick skin from a creature mutated through horrifying experiments. Hard to adapt to the human body, but impenetrable with conventional weapons.
item_mysterious_appendage_description: The viscid limb taken from a deep sea monster.
item_mysterious_cog_description: A simple brass cog. No one knoes its exact function, or can explain the immense power it contains.
item_nightwing_leather_description: High end leather sought after in all the Realms. Retrieving this material is so dangerous that only few people have ever owned it.
item_obsidian_chunk_description: Dark, reflective stone famous for its durability, and sharpness when broken into pieces.
item_orb_of_ectoplasm_description: An orb of otherworldly matter, stirring upon itself in an endless dance.
item_orichalcum_ingot_description: Unbreakable metal from another world. Sacrifices malleability to increase its resistance.
item_orichalcum_scraps_description: Pieces of an unbreakable metal that can be melted into ingots.
item_pearl_description: Perfectly round and with a smooth surface. Very prized material for jewelers.
item_permafrost_core_description: Unstable core that instantly freezes everything around it.
item_permafrost_essence_description: Stabilized Permafrost Core, can be used to craft powerful items.
item_phoenix_feather_description: A feather plucked from the mythical Phoenix.
item_phylactery_fragment_description: Fragment of a powerful artifact. Has something to do with death-altering magic.
item_plant_fiber_description: A base ingredient used in the production of textiles.
item_poisonous_flesh_description: The flesh of a mushroom that lives deep underground. It contains a strange poison with a paralyzing effect, and requires careful handling.
item_prehistoric_mixture_description: A strange amalgam of ingredients from the depths of the Forgotten Lands, seamlessly fused together and exhibiting unique catalytic properties.
item_primeval_scale_description: The enormous scale making up the armor of a colossal Wurm roaming below the Southern Grove.
item_primordial_essence_description: The essence of a primordial being, commonly used as alchemic ingredient.
item_prismatic_essence_description: Stabilized essence displaying a variety of colors, elementally neutral but radiating pure arcane energy.
item_pterodactyl_claw_description: Giant claw of a flying monster previously thought to be extinct.
item_quartz_description: Hard, crystalline mineral found rarely in the deserts and prized for its beauty.
item_radiating_nucleus_description: A powerful, magical device that can store an immense amount of energy. Serves as an engine for Laroxian constructs.
item_recurve_blade_description: A peculiar recurve blade. Unusable in the current state as it\'s handle is missing.
item_redwood_description: Peculiar wood from the far east, rarely found in trading points thanks to traveling merchants. Displays a characteristic red shade.
item_ruby_description: Deep red gemstone with a rich allure, and used to craft a wide range of jewels
item_rune_of_power_description: Rune carefully engraved with great mastery into a simple rock, capable of increasing the power of a wizard by orders of magnitude.
item_sandstone_description: A stone made of sand solidified into a stone-like block.
item_scanner_description: An unknown device made of flesh, metal and stone. Seems capable to detect movement without relying on light.
item_scarlet_strand_description: Gift from an ancient divine force to its worshippers. Only a few exemplars are known to exist, and their strength and quality is legendary.
item_scrap_metal_description: Pieces of metal that usually comes from broken battle gear. Can be smelted into ingots and recycled.
item_seal_of_claris_description: Magic seal of Claris, the rebel Cultist.
item_sentient_slab_description: A stone slab from one of the titans created in secret with a cursed ritual.
item_shadow_gem_description: When a living being touches this gem, whatever their nature is, they are instantly drawn to darkness.
item_shadow_potion_description: With a bright purple color, items can be infused to provide bonuses in dark areas.
item_shahuri_bow_frame_description: The bow frame used to make the renowned Sha\'huri bows.
item_sharp_rib_description: A rib ripped from an undead soldier. It\'s well conserved and very sharp.
item_silk_fabric_description: Luxurious, smooth fabric prized for its softness and sheen. Used to craft superior light clothing.
item_silk_thread_description: Delicate fiber used to weave the fabric of the same name.
item_sinister_stabilizer_description: A powerful catalyst used to clear the arcane properties of powerful artifacts that may be cursed, or magically bound to another entity.
item_soul_shard_description: Condensed fragment of the multitude of souls, crystallized inside the creature they inhabited.
item_spectral_cloth_description: Otherworldly textile made with a glowing thread. Clearly not crafted by human hands.
item_spellwoven_hide_description: Skin of a creature conjured through a spell, persisting in this world after its defeat.
item_spellwoven_leather_description: Leather made from the skin of a creature summoned through magical means.
item_spider_leg_description: Leg of a Giant Spider. Can be used as alchemic ingredient.
item_spider_silk_description: Made from an almost indestructible thread, this light material offers protection with minimal hindrance to one\'s movements.
item_spirit_candle_description: A magic candle of mysterious origin. It never burns out, and cannot be extinguished with any known mean.
item_spitfang_scale_description: Light and resilient scale making up the skin of a Spitfang.
item_star_fragment_description: A fragment of a distant star, containing an immense amount of power.
item_static_core_description: Unstable core displaying an extremely strong electric field.
item_static_essence_description: Stabilized Static Core, can be used to craft powerful items.
item_sunfire_core_description: Unstable core burning with the power of a small sun.
item_sunfire_essence_description: Stabilized Sunfire Core, can be used to craft powerful items.
item_synapse_description: A small wire capable of conducting electric and thermal energy extremely well.
item_tattered_hide_description: The decomposed hide of an undead war beast.
item_terrorsaurus_fang_description: Giant tooth of a voracious creature found in the depth of the world.
item_thaumaturgic_blood_description: Once infected blood drawn from a fearsome ghoul, it has been purified by a powerful reagent. Unlike the base ingredient, it displays powerful healing properties.
item_tortoise_thorn_description: A very sharp thorn broken off a Giant Tortoise shell.
item_troll_hide_description: Hard as a stone but light as regular leather. Used to craft superior quality equipment.

pet_beetle_description: A small, hard-shelled insect with sturdy legs and antennae. It scuttles with purpose, often gleaming in metallic colors.
pet_crocodile_description: A massive, armored reptile with powerful jaws and a stealthy, low-slung body. It lurks in water, ready to launch explosive ambushes with a swift lunge.
pet_dove_description: A gentle bird with soft feathers and a cooing call. It soars gracefully through the air, often seen as a symbol of peace and harmony.
pet_eagle_description: A fierce bird of prey with sharp talons and keen vision. It flies high above, scanning for prey with intense focus, before diving with unmatched speed and precision.
pet_floating_eye_description: A hovering orb of flesh, bristling with tendrils and stalks. Its gaze is unsettling, filled with cold, alien intelligence.
pet_floating_seed_description: A small, round seed with a helix-like appendage. It just shuffles about, searching for fertile ground.
pet_golem_description: A small, compact figure of dense stone and clay. Despite its size, it’s incredibly tough and unyielding, moving with steady purpose, driven by an inner force.
pet_holy_tree_description: A small bonsai tree not taller than the average human. Despite its unassuming appearance, these trees belong to an almost extinct ancient species of sentient trees.
pet_lizard_description: A small reptile with agile limbs and darting eyes. It scurries nimbly over rocks and through foliage, quick to flick its tongue and bask in the sun.
pet_mosquito_description: A tiny, buzzing insect with needle-like mouthparts. It flits through the air with an annoying persistence, always seeking a warm-blooded host to siphon from.
pet_owl_description: A nocturnal bird with large, forward-facing eyes and a round face. It glides silently on wide wings, its haunting hoot echoing through the darkness.
pet_rat_description: A quick, wiry rodent with sharp teeth and twitching whiskers. It scurries in the shadows, scavenging for scraps and finding its way into the smallest crevices.
pet_red_wolf_description: Rare wolf sometimes found roaming the forests looking for prey. It has a timid and elusive nature, but it\'s also extremely loyal.
pet_rockling_description: A squat, rocky creature covered in jagged stone plates. It shuffles slowly, grinding against the earth, its mineral-rich body blending seamlessly with crags and boulders.
pet_squirrel_description: A sleek, agile rodent with sharp claws and a bushy tail. It moves with a silent grace, watching its surroundings with a mix of curiosity and calculated intent. Loves to eat nuts.
pet_tarantula_description: A large, hairy spider with eight watchful eyes and thick, bristling legs. It moves slowly and deliberately, ready to pounce or retreat into the shadows.
pet_tentacle_tangle_description: A writhing, pulsating clump of rubbery tendrils, constantly coiling and twisting. It slithers with unsettling grace, its searching limbs probing for anything to grasp.
pet_tesseract_description: A shimmering, geometric construct that defies conventional shapes. It twists in and out of itself, folding space in mind-bending ways, giving glimpses into other dimensions.
pet_thing_from_the_abyss_description: A shadowy, amorphous entity with flickering, spectral limbs and piercing, formless eyes. Very small for the abyssal horrors standards, but it still radiates a cold dread.
pet_tree_frog_description: A small, bright green amphibian with a powerful legs. Its sharp, resonant croak echoes through the forests, and it has a voracious appetite for anything it can swallow.
pet_walking_bush_description: A dense, thorny shrub with rustling leaves that move on their own. It scuttles across the ground, roots writhing like legs, driven mostly by its curiosity.

weapon_bow_infernal_bow_description: The heart of this unique bow has been replaced with Infernite, an exotic material that maintains its shooting speed while enhancing its tensile strength.
weapon_bow_mithril_bow_description: An incredibly light and resistant bow crafted from the legendary Mithril.
weapon_bow_oblivion_description: This unforgiving weapons is imbued with the very essence of darkness. It shoots arrows with unmatched strength, often STUNNING the target it hits.\nSTUN: the unit skips its turn
weapon_bow_obsidian_bow_description: Sculpted from a single obsidian block, this unusual bow\'s weight is even more balanced than the classical, wooden ones.
weapon_bow_redwood_bow_description: Resistant bow made of redwood, a light and flexible material imported from far away.
weapon_bow_serpent_sting_description: An eldritch artifact from another world. This crossbow generates tensile strength beyond mortal limits. While it delivers massive damage, the recoil STUNS the wielder for one turn after each attack. This effect cannot be cleansed, and ignores immunities.\nSTUN: the unit skips its turn.
weapon_bow_shadow_bow_description: Infused with a Shadow Potion, this bow grants its owner the feats of a nocturnal predator.
weapon_bow_shahuri_bow_description: A bow made with a process known only to the people of the desert. Arrows shot with it can rarely stun their target.\nSTUN: the unit skips its turn
weapon_bow_stellar_flare_description: Further enhanced by an ancient, long-forgotten ritual, this bow hits with the strength of a stellar crown\'s flare.\nSTUN: the unit skips its turn
weapon_bow_titanic_might_description: Infused with the powder resulted from a successful, albeit unethical, experiment from the Cultist rebels. Every property of this bow has been enhanced, thanks to the unwilling sacrifice of their victims.\nSTUN: the unit skips its turn
weapon_bow_training_bow_description: An inefficient bow used mainly for training
weapon_bow_vampire_bow_description: Alchemic result of a long research, its arrows can draw energy from the wounds inflicted and heal the owner for a part of it.
weapon_bow_verdant_bow_description: Made of the finest wood in the Realms, this bow can withstand an extreme tension without ever breaking.
weapon_bow_winterwood_bow_description: Superior bow made with the elusive winterwood, shoots arrows with very high strength and precision.
weapon_bow_wooden_bow_description: A simple bow made of flexible wood
weapon_dagger_animated_dagger_descriptio: Dagger made from Animated Metal, pulsating in a pale blue light.
weapon_dagger_arcane_dagger_description: Exclusive blade gifted from the Seer to its assassins, able to pierce even the thickest steel.
weapon_dagger_banshee_dagger_description: Short knife build from a Banshee claw, which takes advantage of the very sharp edge to inflict tremendous damage.
weapon_dagger_black_iron_dagger_descript: Knife made with the pirate\'s Black Iron.
weapon_dagger_ceremonial_dagger_descript: A blade crafted for the ancient rituals of the mountain Trolls. While its combat effectiveness is far inferior to that of a simple dagger, a lingering spell imbued in the weapon grants it power in other, more mystical ways.
weapon_dagger_corrupted_dagger_descripti: A dagger of fine making, rendered useless by the curse of the Serpent.
weapon_dagger_crystal_dagger_description: With a blade derived from an original Frost Crystal, inflicts tremendous damage when striking vulnerable points.
weapon_dagger_dryads_curse_description: With a resilient Dryad hair running upon its edge, this weapon can cut through defensive spells like an axe through butter.
weapon_dagger_fang_dagger_description: A dagger made with a huge wolf fang in place of the blade.
weapon_dagger_flying_reaper_description: This flying knife can be thrown to enemies, and recalled with a single gesture.
weapon_dagger_frostmetal_dagger_descript: Dagger made with the coldest Frostmetal.
weapon_dagger_fullmoon_dagger_descriptio: Dagger that uses the tooth of a wolf as a blade. However, this particular tooth seems to exhibit some weird properties.
weapon_dagger_glass_knife_description: A sharp dagger with an edge made of glass.
weapon_dagger_infernal_chakram_descripti: The razor-sharp edges of this circular weapon, expertly forged from Infernite, make it lethally effective against enemies at any range.
weapon_dagger_infinite_despair_descripti: Grants a premature end to both the wielder and their enemies.
weapon_dagger_mithril_dagger_description: An incredibly light and resistant dagger crafted from the legendary Mithril.
weapon_dagger_mottiphobia_description: The blade of this dagger is colonized with small flying critters gathered from an ethereal dream. They will help the holder by swarming a random target, dealing a ranged attack with damage equal to the holder\'s HP.
weapon_dagger_mutual_despair_description: Grants a swift demise in skilled hands, demanding a painful toll from its wielder in return.
weapon_dagger_obsidian_dagger_descriptio: Extremely sharp weapon with a blade in Obsidian.
weapon_dagger_orichalcum_dagger_descript: An extremely sharp blade crafted from an unbreakable metal from another world.
weapon_dagger_ritual_blade_description: A dull blade, unfit for combat but designed for esoteric rituals to honor the mountain gods. Magically enhanced by the gems embedded in its handle, it grants its wielder healing powers.
weapon_dagger_serpent_lunge_description: An eldritch artifact from another world. The holder blinks randomly between dimensions, making them difficult for enemies to target.
weapon_dagger_shadow_dagger_description: A blade drawn by darkness, turns its owner into a dangerous night hunter.
weapon_dagger_sickle_description: A farming tool used to cut and trim
weapon_dagger_sylvan_mandate_description: Infused by divine light, this dagger embodies the will of the forest and grants its holder with the power to enact it.
weapon_dagger_undead_knife_description: A dagger made with a long, sharpened undead rib.
weapon_dagger_vampire_dagger_description: With an extremely sharp blade, has been enhanced to draw energy from wounded enemies.
weapon_dagger_verdant_blade_description: An unusual dagger with a Spitfang tooth instead of a blade.
weapon_staff_animated_staff_description: Staff made from Animated Metal, pulsating in a pale blue light.
weapon_staff_black_iron_scepter_descript: Crafted with the most popular iron variation among the pirates, this staff is well balanced and allows magic to flow within with little resistance.
weapon_staff_cane_description: A wooden cane, without any magical properties.
weapon_staff_corrupted_staff_description: A staff built by expert hands, rendered useless by the curse of the Serpent.
weapon_staff_crimson_leech_description: Corrupted with an otherworldly force bound by an alchemist through forbidden rituals, grants the holder a fragment of the power of the Unholy Serpent.
weapon_staff_crystal_staff_description: Built from the remains of an Ice Elemental, this superior staff has the additional property of making the holder resistant to harmful statuses.
weapon_staff_cursed_scepter_description: A terrible instrument when wielded by the right hands, this unholy weapon will raise walking nightmares from defeated enemies.
weapon_staff_death_ray_scepter_descripti: A staff relying on celestial technology that can focus its ray into a thin, but perfectly aimed ray that hits its target with unmatched precision. An unknown device, inorganic but capable of behaving as a living creature, has been integrated in the scepter\'s mechanism to unlock its true damaging potential.
weapon_staff_dreamwrought_staff_descript: Ethereal staff made from an impossible metal, brought to reality by an otherworldly being.
weapon_staff_dryads_blessing_description: An average staff when considering its offensive potential, this intricate weapon really shines in the hands of an experienced healer.
weapon_staff_enchanted_staff_description: An ancient seed from an Ent makes this staff a bit attuned to the holder\'s magic.
weapon_staff_focused_scepter_description: A magic staff built with an alien alloy, integrated with an organic construct able to focalize the energy released into a ray as thin as a hair. While not as powerful as many alternatives, this staff completely nullifies any dispersion of the caster\'s energy.
weapon_staff_icicle_description: Staff built around an ice magic generator, enhancing the holder\'s magic with the power of frost.\nFREEZE: This unit can\'t dodge and takes 10 physical damage each turn.
weapon_staff_imperial_staff_description: A staff traditionally held by the powerful Imperial Mages, working with the Empire\'s army. Only the best pieces from the Golden City artisans make it to the battlefield.
weapon_staff_molten_staff_description: A poorly contained fire magic engine allows mages to channel their powers through this staff, albeit inaccurately.
weapon_staff_obsidian_scepter_descriptio: Perfectly balanced scepter sculpted from obsidian, offers minimal resistance to the owner\'s flow of magic.
weapon_staff_panopticon_staff_descriptio: Aligned Beholder irises allows for the dispersion of light from the caster\'s spells to be focused with a constructive interference, producing a large amount of light.
weapon_staff_serpent_staff_description: An eldritch artifact from another world. Significantly impairs the holder\'s control over white magic, but confers a the buff \"FRENZY\" for 3 turns to every target hit.\nFRENZY: This unit deals 30% increased damage.
weapon_staff_staff_of_the_archmage_descr: Powerful staff used by Laroxian mages. Using their extensive magical knowledge, this staff energy source was bound with complex spells into a high-energy state. The crafting process is long and expensive, and they are held only by the most powerful wizards.
weapon_staff_stellar_staff_description: Infused with the essence of a distant star, this staff burns hotter than any flame known to this world.
weapon_staff_sun_staff_description: A fire artifact has been isolated into the staff\'s head, granting its wielder a better control on fire magic.
weapon_staff_sylvan_blessing_description: The gift of light was bestowed upon this staff, granting it an exponentially higher power and ability to protect allies.
weapon_staff_undead_staff_description: Made with undead remains, allows for some control over the flow of magic forces.
weapon_staff_unstable_staff_description: Magic staff that draws its power from an arcane gem of unpredictable behaviour. The energy released will vary greatly without a known pattern.
weapon_staff_vampire_scepter_description: Enhanced with a peculiar brew, empowers the holder\'s magic with the ability to return from the target as a healing force.
weapon_staff_wicked_scepter_description: A horrible weapon instinctively repelling all living beings, though no one can explain the cause of this feeling. When the wielder summons a minion, this staff will summon a powerful accessory bound to it.
weapon_staff_winterwood_staff_descriptio: The peculiar properties of the material allows for good magic attunement, making it a prized possession among spellcasters.
weapon_sword_abyssal_cutlass_description: A variation of the typical Cutlass, forged using an enhanced metal to make it lighter.
weapon_sword_aegis_description: An ancient artifact of unknown origin, held by the heroes who wish to protect the weak. Will taunt enemies for 2 turns on hit.\nTAUNT: the taunting unit is always chosen as target
weapon_sword_aegis_mechanica_description: Enhanced with mechanical parts taken by a mysterious, ancient creature. This unique artifact will change its shape by pressing a small trigger on its hilt, and is able to reach far away targets. Will taunt enemies for 2 turns on hit.\nTAUNT: the taunting unit is always chosen as target
weapon_sword_animated_sword_description: Sword made from Animated Metal, pulsating in a pale blue light.
weapon_sword_black_iron_cutlass_descript: A curved blade commonly wielded by Skull Island pirates.
weapon_sword_celestial_mercy_description: A Celestial Sword imbued with a fluid typically used as fuel for advanced Celestial ships. When ignited, the fluid emits a bright light but does not harm the blade, thanks to the unique metal of its construction. Deals damage in a broader area, landing hits even when they should miss.
weapon_sword_celestial_sword_description: Sword made from an alien alloy, with a durability above every known material.
weapon_sword_colossal_sword_description: The sword of a colossal titan, too heavy to be held by a common human.
weapon_sword_copper_sword_description: A standard iron sword commonly used throughout the Realms.
weapon_sword_decomposed_limb_description: The rotting limb of an undead creature
weapon_sword_dreadful_morningstar_descri: A terrible weapon taken from a nightmarish knight. When the holder hits an enemy it has a chance to inflict TERRIFY on them.\nTERRIFY: The unit skips its turn and takes 20% max hp as magic damage.
weapon_sword_frostmetal_sword_descriptio: Thick, heavy sword made from the coldest Frostmetal.
weapon_sword_ghastly_scimitar_descriptio: With a consciousness enhanced by undead spirits, this living sword reacts with heightened speed.
weapon_sword_golden_sword_description: Superior swords issued to the Imperial Army infantry.
weapon_sword_living_scimitar_description: A living weapon imbued with the spirit of a Djinn. Will sometimes act on its own, showing incredible mastery.
weapon_sword_living_whip_description: An unconventional weapon made with improvised materials, after careful research about the nature of the mysterious Dryad\'s hairs. Taunts enemies on hit for one turn, and has much greater range than the regular melee weapons.\nTAUNT: the taunting unit is always chosen as target
weapon_sword_mithril_sword_description: An incredibly light and resistant sword crafted from the legendary Mithril.
weapon_sword_obsidian_sword_description: A double edged sword made with the sharpest stone. Can inflict terrible wounds with one swing.
weapon_sword_orichalcum_sword_descriptio: A large sword made from Orichalcum, an unbreakable metal from another world.
weapon_sword_scimitar_description: Sword with a peculiar, recurve blade used by the Sha\'huri people of the Desert.
weapon_sword_serpent_bite_description: An eldritch artifact from another world. A tangible paradox allowing the holder to blend in more effectively with its surroundings, and allowing them to deal more damage the less they blend in.
weapon_sword_serpent_jaws_description: The jaws of a slithering undead monster.
weapon_sword_spade_description: A simple tool used for farming
weapon_sword_undead_sword_description: A grim sword made with undead remains.
weapon_sword_unholy_sword_description: Antithesis to all that is holy, will inflict damage to any enemy entering it\'s malevolent aura.
weapon_sword_vampire_sword_description: An Obsidian Sword that gained the ability to draw energy from enemies, restoring the holder HP.
weapon_sword_void_crusher_description: An enormous sword, so heavy that it can\'t be lifted by any human. Imbued with the power of darkness, it deals enormous damage.
